system.description:
She escaped her father through cleverness. The best move is always the one nobody sees coming.

  • Dark Gift (1st): For 1 Patron Favour, become invisible for 1 minute. Ends only if you attack or cast offensively — not when interacting with objects.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): For 1 Patron Favour, perfectly forge any document, signature, or official seal you have examined for at least 1 minute. The forgery is undetectable without magical means.
  • Patron Feature (8th): For 1 Patron Favour, perfectly impersonate anyone studied for 1 minute — face, voice, mannerisms. Indistinguishable without magic. Lasts 8 hours.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Glasya in the World of Arneyan wiki.
